modules.title: KJV 1611 Marginal Notes
modules.author: King James Translators (1611)
modules.description: Original alternate Hebrew & Greek renderings and marginal notes from the 1611 King James translators.

modules.title: Scofield Reference Notes (1917)
modules.author: C. I. Scofield (1843–1921)
modules.description: Classic 1917 Scofield Reference Bible study notes covering major biblical themes and covenants.

modules.title: Matthew Henry's Commentary
modules.author: Matthew Henry (1662–1714)
modules.description: Beloved six-volume devotional and pastoral exposition of the entire Old and New Testaments.

modules.title: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown
modules.author: Jamieson, Fausset & Brown (1871)
modules.description: Crisp, balanced, scholarly verse-by-verse commentary prized by pastors and Bible teachers.

modules.title: Barnes' Notes on the Bible
modules.author: Albert Barnes (1798–1870)
modules.description: Clear, practical verse-by-verse notes written specifically for Sunday School teachers and Bible readers.

modules.title: John Gill's Exposition
modules.author: John Gill (1697–1771)
modules.description: Exhaustive verse-by-verse exposition of the entire Bible with rich Hebrew, Greek, and historical insight.

modules.title: Spurgeon's Expositions
modules.author: Charles H. Spurgeon (1834–1892)
modules.description: Warm, Christ-centered expositions and preaching insights from the Prince of Preachers.

modules.title: Adam Clarke's Commentary
modules.author: Adam Clarke (1762–1832)
modules.description: Monumental linguistic, historical, and textual commentary across all 66 books.

modules.title: Matthew Poole's Commentary
modules.author: Matthew Poole (1624–1679)
modules.description: Concise, incisive Puritan annotations on the Holy Bible — admired by Spurgeon as a preacher's companion.

modules.title: Keil & Delitzsch (Old Testament)
modules.author: C. F. Keil & F. Delitzsch (1861–1890)
modules.description: Classic scholarly Old Testament commentary grounded in Hebrew grammar and historical context.

modules.title: Vincent's Word Studies (NT)
modules.author: Marvin R. Vincent (1834–1922)
modules.description: Vivid Greek word studies illuminating nuances and imagery across the New Testament.

modules.title: The Companion Bible Notes
modules.author: E. W. Bullinger (1837–1913)
modules.description: Detailed KJV structural notes, figures of speech, and lexical observations.
